agreed: 2026-11-19 (owner: "Everything in the blueprint laid out like rules or applicable to all services should automatically apply to new services or things added during the build")
rule: A rule the blueprint lays down for all services applies to every service, sub-service, feature and screen, existing or new, without being named again. Nothing new waits to be listed by hand: a new billing family fails tests/test_universal.py until it has a home build section here, and from then on every rule below is checked for it automatically. A rule is met (the register shows it), due in a named build section (that section cannot lock until it is met), or not applicable with a written reason (only where the rule allows it). A new rule for all services is added here in the change that agrees it. Read through core/universal.py; tests/test_universal.py.
home_sections_note: The section where the family is finished; a rule not yet met is due there (or in the section being built now, if that is later). LynkAttend, LynkQueue and LynkSurvey were finished in the locked section 3B, so anything still missing for them is a section 4 leftover.
bundles_note: Bundles are tiers over their member services: every rule is met through their members, so they are checked for the catalog, places, picture and build tables only.

rules.what: In the one catalog: page, app path, menu group, picture and footer place
Shown in every place it belongs: header, launcher, search, help, product page, sitemap, footer, pricing, app navigation
An open API with consent per scope, metered and audited
Every step someone waits on is a tracked kind, with the five states, customer view, chains, promised times and the API
Its automations in the register, at the right level, with Why did this happen? and an off switch
A real-device emulator for every screen it has, on the Emulator Panel
Its links to other services and journeys in the connections register
Its parts named in the build tables, so a section cannot lock without them
An explicit ads decision: its ad places in the ads register, or none
Cash beside the electronic ways wherever money is taken in person
LynkAssist skills through the assist register, never beyond its level
Every message and notice it sends in the message register
Both sides with one name: the workspace and the Storefront
In one of the eight groups of the navigation register (header menu, launcher, side bar, footer, search)

everywhere.what: Only queued, sent, accepted, confirmed, failed shown to users
Every screen in all 38 languages, right to left included, no English left, no raw word names
Every screen fits every device and width, turns and folds without loss, menus never squeeze, pop-ups fit
Colours, fonts, sounds, icons and logos only from tokens and the brand module; script rules on every page
One safe page policy, no web loads, a Draft design label
Shown in every country; regulated parts say Coming to your country soon until their partner signs
Every security control in the security register; hash-chained event log; device-signed sessions
Integer money only, never held by LynkOmni, success only when the provider confirms
Every price locked and pinned; support level, ads on Free and Powered by from the plan
Identifiers only from the id registry; addresses, emails and paths only from the catalog
First screen and first tap within the speed budget
Open to every entity: person, company, organisation; the entity changes only words
Every screen has its page template and a way in; anything used often is at most three taps from Home; focus screens show only Back or Cancel and the connection chip
Cached content first; otherwise a skeleton shaped like the content (never before 300 ms, never under 300 ms, a 'taking longer' note with Retry after 8 s); still under reduced motion and lite mode
Every typing field has a hint (an example, never the instruction) in every language and keeps its visible label; sensitive fields never show example values
Every list and page has its designed empty state with a picture and a next step; no filler text such as Latin filler or TODO

Every sound and vibration has an on/off switch; a person's choice lives once in their account, is remembered and followed on every device and page; a shared device follows its manager; only security and safety alerts always sound; a sound is never the only signal

Every Lynk name a person sees carries its plain word (and, where the page has room, what it does), from the names register, in all 38 languages, inside and outside the app: screens, search and its keywords, page titles and sharing cards, LynkAssist, voice menus, messages, LynkOmni's own bills, printed receipts and documents for customers, developer and staff pages. A new product, service, feature, card group or device is added to the register first, in the same change, with its plain word (passing the plain-word check), description, spoken form, mark, similar group where it sounds like another, and a now-called line when it replaces an old name

Every service where a person buys from a provider (airtime, data, eSIMs, bills, subscriptions, fees, tickets, transport, transfers, loans, insurance, savings and any new one) uses the one pay-a-provider flow of blueprint section 85 with its own steps: country, provider, the provider's real offers and prices in the person's currency with the fee shown, details checked with the provider, review and pay, and the result only on the provider's confirmation; money only through licensed partners, "Coming to your country soon." where none is signed
everywhere.enforced_by: built in section 9 (build table 85.6); its tests join there

everywhere.what: Every shared staff device signs each person in with their own PIN, has a duress PIN with a quiet limited view and a silent alert, waits then locks after wrong PINs (never wipes) and locks itself when left; basic phones take a duress PIN too

tracking.lynkassist: LynkAssist's own runs are shown through the service it acts in and its history; it has no steps of its own
tracking.lynkstat: Reports and dashboards are read at once; nobody waits on steps
tracking.lynkdev: API calls answer at once; app review is tracked as a support case kind when built

ads.lynkattend: Attendance doors and staff records: no ad places
ads.lynkcheckout: Payment and pay-link screens never carry ads
ads.lynkmotion: Tracking and safety screens: no ad places
ads.lynkguard: Safety and protection screens: no ad places
ads.lynkjobs: People's job applications: no ad places
ads.lynkschool: Children's and school places never carry ads
ads.lynkproperty: Tenants' and owners' records: no ad places
ads.lynkacademy: Learning places used by children never carry ads
ads.lynkgrow: Growth tools sell the merchant's own offers; no third-party ad places
ads.lynkbet: Betting is never advertised and LynkBet screens never carry ads (catalog/ads.v1.json blocks gambling)

cash.lynkstat: Reports only; it takes no money in person
cash.lynkattend: Takes no money; it takes no money in person
cash.lynksurvey: Takes no money; it takes no money in person
cash.lynkchat: Takes no money; it takes no money in person
cash.lynkdev: Remote only; it takes no money in person
cash.lynkfiles: Takes no money; it takes no money in person
cash.lynkhr: Takes no money; it takes no money in person
cash.lynkproject: Takes no money; it takes no money in person
cash.lynkexchange: Cash is never offered for exchange
cash.lynkvote: Takes no money; it takes no money in person
cash.lynkcheckout: Remote payments: cash is never offered
cash.lynkmpay: Electronic payments; cash is taken at the till by LynkPOS
cash.lynkrecover: Collections are remote; cash at a counter goes through LynkPOS
cash.lynkstock: Stock records; money is taken by LynkPOS
cash.lynkrewards: Points; money is taken by LynkPOS
cash.lynkgrow: Takes no money; it takes no money in person
cash.lynkqueue: Takes no money; payment at the counter goes through LynkPOS
cash.lynkessential: Bills paid remotely through the provider; cash at an agent point goes through LynkPOS
cash.lynkjobs: Job fees and passes are paid remotely; no money is taken in person

emulator.lynkassist: Runs inside every emulator's screens; it has no device of its own

automations.lynkassist: LynkAssist acts inside other services' automations through its assist role; it has none of its own

areas_note: Which areas of the LynkAssist register (catalog/assist.v1.json) and the message register (catalog/messages.v1.json) belong to each family. A family with no area here has its LynkAssist skills and messages due in its home section; its build adds the area here and its entries there.
